subject: Vendor onboarding & PO: privacy intake for ArborHealth
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding & PO: privacy intake for ArborHealth

Hi Liam —

Great to kick this off. We're excited to get ArborHealth onto Redwood for pilot testing. To get procurement moving we generally need three things up front:

1) A completed vendor onboarding form (I attached our standard onboarding PDF).
2) Confirmation on whether ArborHealth requires us to sign your DPA or whether you'll sign ours (attached draft).
3) A current subprocessor list + data retention expectations (field-level retention windows if you have them).

Operational notes: finance requires a PO number before we enable production keys. If you can share the PO timeline (or who in procurement to coordinate with), we can align rollout dates. Typical timeline after PO is 7–10 business days for account enablement.

Quick asks (we can do these in parallel):
- Liam: please attach your vendor questionnaire (if you have one) and the current subprocessor list.
- Laura (finance): I'll loop you on the PO process and expected billing cadence.
- Marissa/Legal: if we need to sign ArborHealth's DPA instead, can you flag non-starters?

Attachments: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.docx

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Head of GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 415‑555‑0123

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arborhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: ArborHealth Procurement <procurement@arborhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 12:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO: privacy intake for ArborHealth

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear list. Attaching our questionnaire and a recent subprocessor export (see attachment). A few quick items:

- We can sign Redwood's DPA if the terms are within our standard thresholds (data residency controls and a 3‑year retention default). If there are material redlines we will send them back for review.
- Subprocessors: we use AWS (S3/EC2), Segment for event routing, and Sentry for error metrics. The attached file has contact points and SOC2 dates.
- PO: procurement@arborhealth.com handles POs — typical turnaround is 5–8 business days once contract and W9 are in place.

Please confirm whether you require KMS integration (customer key) or if Redwood manages encryption keys. Also, can you confirm the default data retention policy applied by Redwood for Pilot data?

Attachment: Arbor_Vendor_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 74KB); Arbor_Subprocessors_20261125.csv

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Sr. Vendor Manager
ArborHealth
liam.oconnor@arborhealth.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2026 08:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO: privacy intake for ArborHealth

Looping in a couple of quick clarifications from the security/compliance side:

- Retention: our standard pilot retention for customer‑owned data is 90 days by default unless the customer requests otherwise. We can configure per‑project retention windows; if ArborHealth needs 3 years for specific fields we'll need a documented justification and a plan to minimize PII exposure.
- Keys: Redwood supports both platform‑managed keys and customer‑managed KMS (we can bring your key via AWS KMS or an HSM via our Private offering). If ArborHealth needs customer‑managed keys in the pilot we should note that will push the onboarding window by ~5 business days for security review.
- DPA: Marissa, can you review the attached Redwood_DPA_draft_v1 and advise whether it's acceptable for Arbor to sign or whether we should expect redlines?

Action items:
- Laura: confirm billing cadence and PO contact details (Jonas noted procurement@arborhealth.com; please confirm any required fields on our invoices).
- Jonas: share the onboarding form link (or the filled PDF) and we'll kick off security review.

Thanks —
Hannah
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arborhealth.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & PO: privacy intake for ArborHealth

Thanks Liam — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. Next steps from our side:

1) Laura will reach out to procurement@arborhealth.com to confirm PO fields and billing cadence.
2) Marissa will review the DPA and push any redlines back to you by EOD Wed (we'll try to keep edits minimal).
3) Hannah will schedule the security review for KMS/retention if Arbor requests customer‑managed keys.
4) Jonas (me) — once we have your PO timeline and DPA confirmation, we'll send the DocuSign envelope for signature and target production keys ~7 business days after PO receipt.

Please find attached the onboarding form filled with the basic integration details (we filled what we had; feel free to correct anything).

Attachments referenced: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (filled)

If you prefer a quick call to walk through the subprocessor list and retention options tomorrow morning I'm available 9–11am PT.

Best,
